_comment: Cards for tests/unit/damage/test_prevent_damage_with_effects.py. `t_betrayer` is Khârn the Betrayer's third line alone on a vanilla 5/5 (tough enough to survive the unpreventable hit its test deals): a `prevent_damage` total shield on itself whose 615.5 rider is 'an opponent of your choice gains control of it' (choose_player, then gain_control of the shielded permanent). `t_sigil_betrayer` is the same body with Khârn's Sigil of Corruption beside it, so the two lines are seen to compose. The damage source, the blanket shield and Everlasting Torment come from prevent_damage_into_counters, prevent_all_damage and everlasting_torment.cards.json.
